title: Calibration Record (Simplified Input)
description: A user-friendly form to document a calibration event for a measurement instrument. Captures calibration type, validity period, reference standards used, conditions, and accuracy claims. Automatically converted to a standardised RDF representation (CHAMEO/PMDCo OO-LD). Link this record to the instrument KItem via the 'instrument' field — instruments can have multiple calibration records.

calibration_name.title: Calibration Name
calibration_name.description: Human-readable name for this calibration event. Include type, instrument, and date.

calibration_id.title: Calibration ID
calibration_id.description: Optional IRI slug for this calibration node in the RDF graph. Auto-derived from calibration_name if omitted.

valid_from.title: Valid From
valid_from.description: Date from which this calibration is valid (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

valid_until.title: Valid Until
valid_until.description: Date until which this calibration is valid. Omit if open-ended.

measurement_device.title: Measurement Device IRI
measurement_device.description: IRI of the measurement-device KItem this calibration applies to.

reference_standards.title: Reference Standards
reference_standards.description: IRIs of reference material or specimen KItems used as calibration standards (e.g. Indium, Zinc, Aluminium).

conditions.title: Calibration Conditions
conditions.description: Quantitative conditions under which the calibration was performed. Each entry: name, value, unit.

results.title: Accuracy Claims
results.description: Scalar accuracy results from this calibration. Each entry becomes a MeasurementDatum (IAO_0000109) in the RDF graph. Examples: temperature deviation, correction factor, repeatability.
